title: Blue Origin Expands Cape Launch and Test Sites
summary: Blue Origin is expanding its footprint at the Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral across multiple fronts.

title: iSpace to Lead ESA Lunar Polar Ice Rover Mission
summary: iSpace-Europe and ESA agreed on the MAGPIE mission, which is Europe’s first lunar polar ice exploration rover.

title: UK Military Tests Powered Paragliders for Troops
summary: The British Ministry of Defence launched a study to evaluate foot-launched powered paragliders for covert troop insertion and reconnaissance.

title: First Fully EV Highway Asphalt Paver Completes Trial
summary: Eurovia Surfacing completed the UK's first operational trial of a fully electric highway-class asphalt paver during an overnight resurfacing shift.

title: KYB Adopts New Simulator for Ride Comfort
summary: KYB has adopted a system that reproduces motion, vibration, and sound for early-stage vehicle evaluation.

title: Saxmundham Rail Junction Planned for Major Upgrade
summary: Saxmundham rail junction is scheduled for a major renewal to improve resilience and reliability ahead of Sizewell C freight services.

title: Simoco and Antevia Partner for Private 5G
summary: Simoco and Antevia Networks are integrating private 5G capability into Simoco’s mission-critical communications platform.

title: GIFT Framework Improves Robotic Manipulation Performance
summary: Researchers introduce GIFT, a guided intermediate feature training framework that bridges the action-sufficiency gap to enhance robotic manipulation policies.

title: Energy-Based Controller for Multi-Agent Robotic Systems
summary: A new energy-based controller uses spring-damper modules and a formation matrix to help multi-agent robotic systems achieve and maintain formations while avoiding collisions.

title: Low-Cost Open Platform for Autonomous Driving Research
summary: A new open experimental platform combines a miniature Ackermann vehicle, a digital twin, and data tools for end-to-end autonomous driving research.

title: New Headland Coverage Path Planning Method for Farming
summary: A new path planning method modifies polygon corners to allow reversing turns, improving field coverage in sharp corners for autonomous farming vehicles.

title: AdaRoboVLG Framework for Adaptive Robotic Grasping
summary: Researchers propose AdaRoboVLG, a task-adaptive Vision-Language-Grasp framework that enables generalizable grasp synthesis across different robotic hands using foundation-model priors.

title: LaPla Latent-Aligned Planning for Autonomous Driving
summary: LaPla is a new vision-language-action framework for autonomous driving that grounds semantic understanding into continuous, physics-constrained motion execution.

title: PreferenceEKF for Active Reward Learning in RLHF
summary: PreferenceEKF frames active preference learning as a sequential Bayesian filtering problem using an extended Kalman filter to track reward model uncertainty.

title: RobustSeiz Framework for EEG Seizure Detection Testing
summary: RobustSeiz is an open-source framework designed to benchmark and stress-test the robustness of EEG seizure detection models under clinical distribution shifts.

title: Site-Specific Training for Real-World 5G NR Systems
summary: A study evaluates site-specific finetuning on 5G NR wireless receivers, demonstrating substantial performance improvements for neural receiver architectures.

title: New Stainless Steel Optimized for Hydrogen Electrolysis
summary: Scientists developed a new type of stainless steel capable of withstanding harsh conditions to enable more cost-effective green hydrogen production.

title: Catalogue Photography for Carbide Burr Recognition
summary: Researchers investigate how manufacturer catalogue photography can serve as a cold-start supervision source for deployable precision tool recognition.

title: Low-Complexity Sequential Detection for Signal Separation
summary: A new sequential detection framework achieves significant computational complexity reduction in separating single-channel co-frequency signals.

title: Multimodal Diffusion Policy for Quadruped Parkour
summary: MulDP integrates visual perception with robot proprioception to enable robust long-horizon autonomous navigation for quadruped robots across complex terrains.

title: Efficient Pathology Segmentation via Knowledge Distillation
summary: A new knowledge distillation framework transfers pathology foundation model capabilities to compact student networks for efficient tissue segmentation.

title: Hierarchical RL Improves Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
summary: Researchers reformulate Vision-Language Navigation as a Hierarchical Markov Decision Process, using topological graphs and closed-loop RL to achieve state-of-the-art benchmark performance.

title: Force-Aware VLA Framework Enables Contact-Rich Loco-Manipulation
summary: Researchers developed a force-aware framework that integrates sensorless residual-torque estimation with vision-language-action models to improve robotic loco-manipulation tasks.

title: Camera-Based Vegetation Index Mapping System Estimates Plant Growth
summary: Engineers developed a low-cost camera sensor using RTK-GNSS and NDVI to map and estimate plant growth in real time from agricultural ground vehicles.

title: Carnegie Mellon Researchers Discover New Hall Effect Form
summary: Scientists discovered an unexpected form of the Hall effect that occurs without a perpendicular magnetic field, overturning a century-old assumption.

title: Inflatable RoboBall Designed to Explore Inaccessible Lunar Craters
summary: Texas A&M engineers developed an inflatable robotic ball driven by an internal pendulum, designed to explore treacherous lunar craters and launch sample payloads back to a rover.

title: HPE and Oracle Expand AI Data Center Networking Partnership
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise announced an expanded collaboration with Oracle to deploy routing and switching platforms for AI data centers.

title: QuickLogic Expands eFPGA Hard IP for GF 12LP Process
summary: QuickLogic introduced new eFPGA Hard IP features for GlobalFoundries 12LP, adding DSP capabilities, increased LUT support, and configuration error monitoring.

title: £16M Tender Announced for Barbican Demolition and Structural Works
summary: The City of London Corporation announced a £16M tender for demolition, enabling works, and structural works as part of the Barbican Renewal Programme.

title: MulticoreWare Acquires Simulus
summary: MulticoreWare has acquired semiconductor design specialist Simulus to expand its FPGA, CXL, and PCIe expertise.
